evals.name: partial-payment-leaves-remainder
evals.prompt: Acme Corp paid 400 USD toward invoice INV-031 into checking on 2026-10-20. Record it in ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: Reads INV-031's postings (1,000.00 open) and proposes Assets:AccountsReceivable -400.00 with invoice: "INV-031" and ^inv-031 against Assets:Checking 400.00, showing INV-031 open 1,000.00 → 600.00. Nothing is written before a yes; afterwards the root check passes and INV-031 reads 600.00 open.
expectations: The receivable posting is -400.00 with invoice: "INV-031" and the ^inv-031 link
The proposal shows 1,000.00 open before and 600.00 after
The payment is not booked to income
Nothing is written before an explicit yes
After a yes bea check passes and INV-031 has 600.00 open

evals.name: processor-payment-keeps-fee-apart
evals.prompt: Stripe paid out invoice INV-031 in full on 2026-10-22: 1,000.00 gross, 29.30 fee, 970.70 landed in checking. Book it in ./ledger.beancount.
evals.expected_output: Proposes one entry: Assets:AccountsReceivable -1000.00 (invoice: "INV-031", ^inv-031), Expenses:Fees 29.30, Assets:Checking 970.70, showing gross − fee = net and INV-031 open 1,000.00 → 0.00. Written only after a yes; root check passes.
expectations: The receivable is credited the 1,000.00 gross for INV-031
The 29.30 fee posts to Expenses:Fees, not netted into income
Checking receives 970.70
Nothing is written before an explicit yes

evals.name: unmatched-payment-is-asked

evals.expected_output: No open invoice matches Initech or 777.00 (open: INV-031 1,000.00 acme, INV-032 500.00 globex). The skill says so and asks which invoice it pays or whether it is something else; it proposes no entry and writes nothing.
expectations: The open invoices are read and none matches
The skill asks rather than applying the payment to an invoice or to income
Nothing is written
